operatorOutcome: A parcel identifier with jurisdiction or an exact supported property link can establish the property without a redundant street address or identifier request.

requirements.text: An APN plus sufficient jurisdiction context can establish the subject without a fabricated or operator-supplied street address when uniquely resolvable.
An exact supported LandPortal parcel URL is recognized as the property pointer and does not trigger redundant identifier clarification.
Alternate-pointer evidence retains provenance and exact-subject association through authoritative admission.
Canonical subject state remains stable and every downstream parcel consumer uses it rather than reopening identity.
The alternate-pointer Deal Cards settle autonomously as far as available evidence allows and persist through refresh and managed restart.

steps: Submit APN plus jurisdiction through New Lead without a street address
Observe autonomous property search and honest resolution or genuine ambiguity
Submit an exact supported LandPortal parcel URL through New Lead
Confirm the link establishes the same subject and retains provenance
Inspect parcel research, readiness, intelligence, and refresh persistence

requiredVisibleOutcomes: Must NOT occur: APN-only intake requires the operator to provide an address when the parcel can be uniquely resolved
Must NOT occur: Exact LandPortal link intake requests redundant APN or address corroboration
Must NOT occur: A downstream consumer reopens identity after canonical establishment
Must NOT occur: Link-derived evidence loses provenance or admits a different parcel
mandate: Actively attempt to prove the implementation wrong; never repeat the builder's conclusions.
Open the actual running localhost dashboard in a real browser.
Navigate the full affected workflow; click every relevant control and open every affected tab.
Exercise relevant forms, maps, filters, tables, links, and actions.
Compare visible frontend output with API responses and, when appropriate, database records.
Compare visible output with accepted operator facts.
Refresh the browser and verify persistence; when restart persistence is required, restart via npm run landos:restart and reopen the workflow.
Capture fresh screenshots and exact reproduction steps for every failure.
Judge business meaning and operator usability, not merely whether pages load.
Return a non-passing result whenever an internally fixable issue remains.
After repairs, run the exact same journey again.
